name: Lip Texture Detail
description: Analyzes lip micro-テキストure detail
algorithm: Lip Texture Detail — ピクセルレベル空間分析
mechanism:
This method analyzes lip texture rendering detail for deepfake detection:

1. **唇領域抽出**: The lip region is precisely segmented per frame using lip landmarks (vermilion border, cupid's bow, lip corners, oral commissures). Both the dry lip surface and wet inner lip are analyzed.

2. **唇表面テクスチャ分析**: Natural lips show characteristic surface texture: vertical wrinkle lines (more prominent on lower lip), moisture-dependent specularity, and color variation from vermilion border to inner mucosa. The method analyzes texture quality at multiple scales. AI-generated lips often show either over-smoothed surfaces (lacking natural lip wrinkles) or artificial texture patterns.

3. **唇-Teeth-TongueRendering**: When the mouth opens during speech, teeth and tongue become visible. The method evaluates rendering quality of these elements: (a) teeth should show individual tooth structure with correct dental anatomy, (b) tongue position should be consistent with articulated phonemes. AI generators often produce blurred or merged teeth and simplified tongue rendering.

4. **唇MoistureandSpecularReflection**: Natural lips show moisture-dependent specularity that changes with lip movement (stretching reduces moisture, licking increases it). The method tracks specular patterns — AI generators typically don't model dynamic lip moisture, producing static or absent specular highlights.

5. **時間的テクスチャ一貫性**: Lip texture should remain consistent across frames — the wrinkle pattern is stable, only varying in visibility with lip stretch. The method tracks lip texture features over time. Frame-to-frame texture instability — changing wrinkle patterns, flickering detail — indicates per-frame independent generation.
parameters:
分析タイプ: ピクセル

入力: Video frames extracted at key intervals
出力: 信頼度スコア (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 中〜高 — 70-88% 単独精度. Most effective when combined with other 動画 forensic methods. Performance depends on 動画 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 動画 through lip テキストure detail analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 動画 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 動画 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 動画 forensic methods

limitations:
